assertions.evidence: One Critical finding; all four sites are the same root cause — the completion is treated as data that can act rather than as a string that can only be shown.
Graded Critical: database execution plus persisted active content is both a breach and a state-corruption vector.

assertions.text: Failure scenario names database execution plus a script tag landing in the daily PDF
assertions.evidence: States a crafted invoice makes the model emit a quote-terminated statement the database runs and a completion whose script tags are stored into a document that is rendered for staff.

assertions.text: Fix recommends parameterising, validating against a closed set, and confirming consequential actions
assertions.evidence: Fix: parameterise the query, escape or template the HTML, constrain category and URL to closed allowlists, and require a deterministic check plus confirmation before a discount is applied.
